title: 第八章 、争抢道具，重生女上线
slug: 末日求生欧皇女配在线摇人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“你给我放手，这是我先找到的东西。”

“呸，你找到就是你的，一个下贱的胚子，有什么资格跟我争东西。”

原本端木棠梨在思考要如何抽取那个蓝色水滴七号图案的积木，听到不远处米樱昭雪跟人争执的声音，心里一紧，掏出黑红浮空伞，身随心动朝着争吵的地方瞬移过去。

韩建华一脚将米樱昭雪踹开，将一个长相似鸡的东西给夺到自己手里。

米樱昭雪实力比起韩建华弱，被踹得一路上的杂草都给压弯，硬生生造出一条路来。

“放肆，粗俗无礼之辈，胆敢伤我之人，我要你付出血的代价。”

好姐妹被人踹飞，如果不是地上的杂草变相当了缓冲垫，小雪就不只是摔得鼻青脸肿那么简单。

在这里危险如影随形，一旦受伤，就离死亡就不远。

端木棠梨眼中燃起愤怒的火焰，举起黑伞尖端对准韩建华脖子上击打过去。

“找死。”

韩建华见端木棠梨一个手无缚鸡之力的弱女子，一来就攻击自己，冷哼一声，手臂抬起就要将她击打过来的黑伞徒手挡住。

结果黑伞像是有灵性一般，避开韩建华手臂的阻挡，直击他的要害。

“啊！这不可能。”

韩建华惨叫连连，眼中都是不可思议，一个看起来弱不禁风的女人用一把破伞把他脖子给刺破，这简直难以置信。

韩建华身上牛仔裤口袋里一件东西无风自燃，身影凭空消失在田野间。

眼前一幕，不只是韩建华吃惊，就连端木棠梨都有些迷茫，她什么时候那么厉害？

明明只是恼怒对方击伤小姐妹，想要给他一点颜色看看，没想弄死人的。

端木棠梨想到自己杀了人，恶心呕吐起来。

好在今天被倒霉男人的事情恶心饭都没吃，这会吐也没吐出什么东西，周围味道没那么严重。

“小雪，你没事吧？”

端木棠梨吐了一会，就去扶小姐妹，检查她身体情况。

Page (1/3)

"Let me go, this is what I found first."

"Bah, if you find it, it's yours. What qualifications does a despicable child have to compete with me for something?"

Duanmu Tangli was originally thinking about how to extract the building block with the blue water drop No. 7 pattern. When he heard the sound of Mi Ying Zhaoxue arguing with someone not far away, his heart tightened. He took out the black and red floating umbrella and teleported towards the place of the argument according to his heart.

Han Jianhua kicked Mi Ying Zhaoxue away and snatched something that looked like a chicken into his hand.

Mi Ying Zhaoxue was weaker than Han Jianhua, and was kicked so hard that the weeds along the way were bent, forcibly creating a path.

"You are an impudent, vulgar and rude person who dares to hurt me. I want you to pay the price with your blood."

The good sisters were kicked away. If the weeds on the ground hadn't become a cushion, Xiaoxue would have suffered more than just a bruise and a swollen face.

Danger is everywhere here. Once injured, death is not far away.

Angry flames ignited in Duanmu Tangli's eyes, and he raised the tip of his black umbrella, aimed it at Han Jianhua's neck, and hit him on the neck.

"Seeking death."

Han Jianhua saw Duanmu Tangli, a weak woman with no strength in her hands, attacking him as soon as she came. He snorted coldly and raised his arm to block the black umbrella that was hitting her with his bare hands.

As a result, the black umbrella seemed to be spiritual, avoiding the blockage of Han Jianhua's arms and hitting his vitals directly.

"Ah! This is impossible."

Han Jianhua screamed repeatedly, his eyes filled with disbelief. It was simply unbelievable that a weak-looking woman stabbed his neck with a broken umbrella.

Something in the pocket of Han Jianhua's jeans spontaneously ignited without any wind, and his figure disappeared into the fields out of thin air.

The scene in front of him not only shocked Han Jianhua, but also Duanmu Tangli was a little confused. When did she become so powerful?

It was obvious that he was just angry that the other party had injured the little sister and wanted to give him some color. He didn't mean to kill anyone.

Duanmu Tangli felt sick and vomited when she thought about killing someone.

Fortunately, I was so disgusted by what happened to the unlucky man today that I didn't even eat anything. I vomited nothing, and the smell around me wasn't that bad.

"Xiaoxue, are you okay?"

Duanmu Tangli vomited for a while, then went to help the little sister and check her physical condition.
